step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows SK Telecom's Cloud Management Platform split into CAP (Cloud Admin Portal) and CBP (Cloud Biz Platform). CAP uses External Users leading through CloudFront, ELB, Fargate, ElastiCache, and RDS Aurora via visible arrow connections. CBP shows On-Premise, Direct Connect, SageMaker, S3, and External Data Source without visible connecting arrows.
